skills.name: react-component
skills.description: Creates or extends a React component with a folder per component, an index.ts public surface, typed props, container/presentational split, and a colocated test and story; splits components that pass the line cap. Use when asked to "add a component", "build a UI for", "extract this into a component", "this component is too big", or when creating a .tsx file.

skills.name: react-hook
skills.description: Creates or fixes a custom React hook in a folder-per-hook layout with correct effect cleanup, ref vs state choices, stable callbacks, derived state and data fetching through the project's data library. Use when asked to "make a hook", "extract this into a hook", "fetch data in a component", when fixing a useEffect bug, infinite re-render or stale closure, or when exhaustive-deps complains.

skills.name: react-performance
skills.description: Diagnoses and fixes React rendering and loading performance — measuring with the Profiler first, memo/useMemo/useCallback only with evidence, list virtualisation, code splitting with lazy, context re-render cascades and bundle size. Use when asked "why is this slow", "too many re-renders", "optimise this component", "the list lags", "reduce bundle size", or before adding memoisation.
